idea-plugin.name: Cybersecurity Container Audit
idea-plugin.description:
Reads a Dockerfile or compose file and names the hardening controls it fails, with the NIST SP 800-171 requirement each one puts at risk.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Cybersecurity Container Audit: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 19 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/container-hardening-800-190 (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/container-hardening-800-190

action.text: Cybersecurity Container Audit: Check This File
action.description: Run Cybersecurity Container Audit on the file in the editor
